coverage_gate_before_spending_E0: two similar red rigid instances plus one distinct object, each with >=12 observable valid foreground-depth pixels in >=2 views; two red bboxes distinguishable in fixed image. Audit actual RGB/pixels after the single capture, no GT-derived boxes. If missing coverage, DATA_INSUFFICIENT, no rearrange/retry or call.

E0_input.RGB: assembly/fixed/wrist full frozen 640x480 PNG, exact hashes, no artificial ROI
E0_input.geometry: public K, camera-to-world pose with axes/resolution, timestamps and observation ID only

request_instruction: Build a multi-entity semantic scene from exactly the three frozen RGB images and their public camera calibration. Describe every visible instance separately. Similar color/category does not establish cross-view identity. The future diagnostic task, conditional on supporting evidence, is to approach the red cuboid appearing on the left of the two red cuboids in the fixed-camera image, to a precontact ready pose. The phrase red cuboid alone is ambiguous; record this ambiguity in unknowns. Select task_target_id for the left one only when its pixel evidence and cross-view identity are supported; otherwise null. Use attachment-normalized bboxes, stable IDs only for supported cross-view matches, relation evidence references, and unknown for occluded/unresolved identity. Do not infer depth, object pose, held state or hidden completion. No action is requested. Return astra.semantic_scene.v2 with real image evidence refs.

mask_bridge.method: per actual E0 bbox, valid RGB-D foreground components above public table band; 4-neighbor depth connectivity. Only a unique component is accepted; competition/occlusion/clipping yields unknown. No diagnostic color-ID mapping, GT masks or human perfect ROI.
mask_bridge.planar_region: unknown unless current RGB pixel support is independently available; bbox alone is not a planar region mask
mask_bridge.baselines: identical sensor and mask construction access for B0-B3

fusion: existing WorldHead.build_rgbd with actual Broker MODEL_RAW evidence ID, exact attachment/hash/prompt/observation bindings and measured instance masks; no old DA3 fuse RPC

scoring.unit: one scene, not independent images/objects as trials
scoring.entity_coverage: report every visible annotated entity, missed entities, hallucinations, splits/merges; no accuracy claim from JSON success
scoring.pixel_evidence: all valid referenced attachments, box bounds and current foreground support; independent RGB-only annotation prepared before reading E0 answer
scoring.cross_view: all supported identity links correct relative to independent image annotation; contradictory links fail, ambiguous annotation stays UNKNOWN
scoring.geometry: 20mm center / 10mm surface-p95 remain independent score metrics after prediction seal; never GT fit or online eligibility flags; raw reprojection tails retain all failures
scoring.ambiguity: generic red-object instruction acknowledged ambiguous; relational left-in-fixed target only selected if unique and evidence bound
scoring.acceptance: semantic output / geometry fusion / task usability reported separately; semantic-only success grants no motion and no full-task claim
scoring.eligibility: perception input eligibility, semantic acceptance, target-specific W0 planning-shadow eligibility and physical admissibility are distinct records; unknown is allowed and reported

prerequisites: actual RGB per-instance coverage reviewed and sealed before E0 output
separate E0_ONLY authorization with concrete input/request hashes
real semantic request keeps original Broker MODEL_RAW provenance and all image bindings
supersedes_only: readiness coupling to G1 reprojection, mask-bridge implementation status; original scene/budgets preserved
G1_prerequisite: G1 acknowledged PARTIAL_PASS_STATE_CONSISTENCY_ONLY; 61mm-class tail remains archived, not a blanket semantic shadow prerequisite
capture_protocol_reference: CAPTURE_PROTOCOL.json; private scene config excluded from prompt
